description: Privacy-first social post embed. Renders the authored fallback link plus a "Load … post" button; on activation it builds a sandboxed iframe from the validated post URL (Bluesky, Mastodon, X, Instagram) or a <youtube-player> (YouTube).

attributes.name: url
attributes.description: Post or video URL. Must be https on the provider's own host (Mastodon: any https host with a /@user/<id> path); anything else is unsupported.

attributes.name: provider
attributes.description: Provider key (x, instagram, bluesky, youtube, mastodon or a registered custom key). Skips auto-detection; the provider must still accept the URL.

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: Colour hint for themeable providers (X, Bluesky). auto: the host's computed color-scheme, then the page's data-mode, then prefers-color-scheme.

attributes.name: activate
attributes.description: click: load when the reader presses the Load button; visible: when scrolled within 200px of the viewport; eager: at once. YouTube always renders its own facade at once.

attributes.name: data-title
attributes.description: Accessible name of the embedded frame (YouTube: the player title). Default: "{provider} post" / "YouTube video".

attributes.name: data-label-load
attributes.description: Load button text; {provider} is the platform name, {noun} is post (video for YouTube).

attributes.name: data-label-loading
attributes.description: Button text and live-region announcement while loading.

attributes.name: data-label-error
attributes.description: Visible note and announcement when loading fails (the button stays for a retry).

attributes.name: data-label-note
attributes.description: Consent note beside the Load button; {host} is the host the embed loads from.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Lifecycle state, set by the component.

methods.name: SocialEmbed.register(name, provider)
methods.description: Static. Add a provider { canHandle(url), render(host, url, { theme, title }) → Promise<Node | void>, label?, noun?, themeable?, delegatesActivation?, frameHost(url)? }. A returned Node replaces the fallback. Instances left unsupported re-initialise.

methods.name: createEmbedFrame(options)
methods.description: Module export. Build a sandboxed, lazy https iframe ({ src: URL, title, sandbox: string[], allow?, height?, measure?(data), onload?(frame) }); measure reads a height from the frame's postMessage (origin and source are checked).

methods.name: loadScript(src)
methods.description: Module export. Idempotent script loader for custom providers; a failed load is evicted so it can be retried. Built-in providers never inject script.

methods.name: fetchOEmbed(endpoint, url, params?)
methods.description: Module export. Fetch oEmbed JSON. Never insert its html with innerHTML.
